key_insight: MatCreatioNN combines reinforcement learning MOF generation with a multi-stage CGCNN funnel to rapidly discover photocatalyst candidates that balance light absorption, redox performance, adsorption, and stability.
engineering_relevance: The framework can reduce screening cost while prioritizing synthesizable MOFs for environmental remediation and CO2 conversion, accelerating practical photocatalyst design.
method: Generate 120,000 MOF candidates using reinforcement learning
Screen 13 descriptors with a staged CGCNN prediction funnel
Use post-hoc motif analysis and simulated XRD for synthesizability checks
evidence_signal: The funnel cut computational cost by 4.13× and identified Cr- and Zn-based MOFs with predicted photocatalytic fitness 1.70±0.25 and 1.20±0.05 times above benchmark PCN-224(Zr).
watch_item: Predictions are computational and hinge on sparse experimental validation, so real-world performance, stability, and synthesis yield still need confirmation.
paper_title: MatCreatioNN: Machine learning-guided computational discovery of photocatalysts for environmental applications
